title: Assess, prioritize, and remediate vulnerabilities
reason: High and critical advisories block until updated or exempted with a deadline (supply), and each vulnerability of the repository's own code is a VULN record whose deadline the bug bar sets by severity and which is unconformant once overdue, accepted only until a date, and verified only by a test (security); none is recorded yet, which is a state of the record, not a gap of the process.
